summary: Tested the new batch: dashboard date-range (monthly/action-items/call-report APIs + UI range bar), Team call report card visibility by role, To-do list panel, Propzel rebrand, Business Campaign rename, stage-based Campaign Dialer (preview, skip-today, auto_start, draft, cancel), WhatsApp template picker in inbox and lead detail, Settings cleanup. Backend 21/21 pytest passed. Every frontend flow that was asked for passed. Found no critical bugs, only minor data/UX notes.

minor.issue: 'followups' always comes back as 0, even for a range of all time. It counts activities with kind=followup_scheduled, but the seeded follow-ups (25 pending in follow_ups) never created those activities. Only follow-ups created through the ops route will be counted. Consider counting the follow_ups collection by created_at/created_by instead.

Mocked pending_credentials attempts are saved as outgoing_call activities. This inflates the Outgoing calls / Total calls today numbers and also makes those leads count as 'already called today' for later campaign stage previews. In this run, 'today' outgoing went to 8 and 'skipped' to 7 because of test campaigns. Consider excluding status=pending_credentials.
The telemetry and missed_calls counts are not scoped for executives: they count activities across the whole org. This was already the case before this batch.

issues: The custom From/To fields use the browser's native date picker (input type=date) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover
Range is calculated in browser local time while the backend uses UTC day boundaries, so it can be off by one day near midnight IST

The 'Today's summary' (EOD) and 'Business Campaign · Today' cards stay fixed to today and ignore the page-level period. This could confuse users. Consider labelling them or making them follow the selected range.
After creating a campaign, the Skip-today and Autostart toggles keep the last values the user set instead of going back to the defaults (on)

action_items: Optional: compute the call-report 'followups' value from the follow_ups collection so seeded or older follow-ups are counted
Optional: exclude mocked pending_credentials call attempts from outgoing-call KPIs and from the skip_called_today check
Optional: switch the dashboard custom date inputs to the shadcn Calendar
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.py _parse_range: date_from with no date_to falls back to the default end. If date_from is after the default end, this returns 400, which is acceptable
callerdesk.stage_leads loads up to 5000 leads plus a distinct query, which is fine for now. create_campaign rebuilds set(ids) inside the list comprehension; hoist it out
TeamCallReport swallows API errors silently (catch(() => {})), so there is no error state shown to the user
seed_data_creation: Created campaigns TEST_draft, TEST_auto (x2) and TEST_UI_campaign. All are cancelled, and no active or draft campaigns remain. Template TEST_tpl_greet was created and then deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server date is Oct 23 2026. Presets were verified: today=23 Oct, week=19–23 Oct, last_month=01–30 Sep, 30d=24 Sep–23 Oct. The call report shows for admin and manager and is hidden for executive (priya); the user select changes counts (all 142 -> Priya 48). Stage preview arithmetic: count+skipped with skip on equals count with skip off. The auto-start campaign run returned started=2 with numbers marked pending_credentials. WA template picker substitutes both {name} and {{name}}. Sending fails with an 'Evolution API not connected' toast, which is expected. Settings has no 'Calling & recording'. The browser title is 'Propzel · Real Estate CRM'.
